title: AxFly
description: Take to the skies with a single command!
body:
**AxFly – Take to the Skies with a Single Command!**

AxFly is a simple and lightweight Minecraft plugin that lets players toggle flight on and off with a single command. Just type `/fly` and soar like in Creative mode—no complicated setup required.

**Features:**

* Easy `/fly` toggle for players.
* Flight works just like Creative mode.
* Permission-based control (`axfly.use`).
* Lightweight and compatible with Minecraft 1.21.x (Paper/Spigot).

Perfect for survival servers, mini-games, or anyone who wants the freedom to fly without switching game modes.
